title: a non-reference VVC frame that is output is fully released, returning its pooled side tables while the decoder still holds them
live_proof: the fix is an ANCESTOR of the pin, so the defect is absent from it: `git merge-base --is-ancestor 5c66a3ab51 n9.0.1` succeeds, and the fixed form is present verbatim at n9.0.1:libavcodec/vvc/refs.c:254 as `ref->flags = VVC_FRAME_FLAG_OUTPUT | VVC_FRAME_FLAG_SHORT_REF;`. The case re-introduces the reverse, as the other three in this corpus do. Checked against the backport trap as well: the cherry-pick probe is not what settles this one, because the fix is in by ancestry rather than by a pick
object: a VVC frame's per-frame side tables, tab_dmvr_mvf and rpl_tab, taken from their AVRefStructPools at refs.c:153 and :157
lifetime_ender: ff_vvc_unref_frame clears the frame's last flag, so the `if (!frame->flags)` branch at refs.c:53 runs av_refstruct_unref on both tables, returning them to pool->available_entries
shape: premature return to the pool / reuse / stale read
allocator_layer: AVRefStructPool (libavutil/refstruct.c), with the frame's planes on AVBufferPool alongside
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator: refstruct.c and buffer.c are upstream's, unreduced, and the pool's recycling is its own -- a release pushes the entry onto pool->available_entries (refstruct.c:230-231) and the next av_refstruct_pool_get pops the same one back (:258-261). Reduced is the consumer: ff_vvc_unref_frame's flag arithmetic is transcribed, the frame carries only the fields this defect touches, and no decoder is built. The triggering condition is written out rather than reached through a bitstream: a picture with ph_pic_output_flag set and ph_non_ref_pic_flag set, which is the combination the upstream message names
distinguishing: the only case in this corpus whose stale storage comes from AVRefStructPool rather than AVBufferPool, and the only one whose release is triggered by flag arithmetic rather than by a reference count reaching zero through a consumer's own unref

native-fix-differential.oracle: the buggy arm has both side tables released and one reissued at the same address, and reads the new owner's 0xCC through the stale pointer; the fixed arm keeps VVC_FRAME_FLAG_SHORT_REF set so the release branch never runs and nothing is reissued. The pool's free list is LIFO (pool_return_entry pushes onto pool->available_entries, refstruct_pool_get_ext pops the head), so the entry handed back is rpl_tab, the LAST of the two released -- the oracle tracks both and reports which, via reissued_is_rpl_tab
native-fix-differential.note: this pair differs by the upstream fix, not by protection
native-fix-differential.measured: 2026-10-03, results/2026-10-03-native-four-cases/: buggy arm tables_released=1 reuse_same_address=1 reissued_is_rpl_tab=1 stale_read=0xCC -> DEFECT-REPRODUCED; fixed arm tables_released=0 -> FIXED. run-native.sh exited 0 over all four cases

sublet-port.oracle: case.c unchanged against the Sublet port of FFmpeg's own pools (app port, FFAPP_POOL=sublet): the defect faults at an instruction case.c's line table puts on a line that dereferences the stale table pointer, before the verdict line; the fix completes with VERDICT FIXED
sublet-port.control: the same case.c and driver objects linked against upstream's pools (FFAPP_POOL=stock): the defect completes with VERDICT DEFECT-REPRODUCED, the fix with VERDICT FIXED

spatial.role: control for sublet: same binary and guest, one difference

sublet.oracle: fault at the labelled read probe
sublet.measured: 2026-10-04, same bundle: mode 2 faulted with cause 24 at pc 0x101a11720 == expected_pc, exactly one fault; the same domain_sha256 ac4473aa27353f9e in both modes, so the pair differs only in the runtime mode argument

status: declared 2026-10-03; the native-fix-differential arm MEASURED the same day (bug-corpora/ffmpeg/pool-repros/results/2026-10-03-native-four-cases/), and the spatial/sublet pair MEASURED 2026-10-04 as probe case 39 (ports/ffmpeg/buffer-pool/results/measurements/20261004-vvc-case3-probe39/), both cells as pre-registered in a9a5df563658. The sublet-port rows (fixtures 46/47) remain PREDICTIONS: they need the FFmpeg app port, and have simply not been run. RETRACTED 2026-10-04, same day: the earlier wording here said that port's SDK ABI gate 'refuses every toolchain on this host for want of the intcap extensions'. That is false. A qualified toolchain IS present -- llvm-capstone-cc/build-release/bin/clang, commit 7d01722aab88 -- and check_toolchain accepts it end to end (both the two-call direct-call probe and __uintcap_t pass). The error was generalising from a glob over */llvm/cmake-build-* to 'every toolchain on this host'; docs/ref/ffmpeg-live-defect-triage.md:281-284 already named that compiler. So sublet-port is reachable and merely unrun. The fault lines were re-registered 84,85,88 -> 99,100,103 -> 104,105,108 when the reduction was corrected to track both released tables and to give rpl_tab its own fill; the predicted outcomes did not change.
note: The arms left 'not written' are the ones this case cannot honestly carry yet: the PoisonCap and CheriBSD arms need platforms this host does not have, and native-detect would measure the fixture rather than FFmpeg because the port's payload arena is one allocation. spatial and sublet were filled on 2026-10-04 by probe slot 39 in ports/ffmpeg/buffer-pool, which is what this note previously said was missing; 36-38 remain cases 0-2.
